goal: Migrate Ledger Accounts to Effect and move Currency ownership from Ledger to Account.

tasks.name: Add shared ledger values and the Account domain
inputs: Existing Ledger and Organization domain patterns
tasks.description: Add pure shared Currency, exponent, Minor Unit, and Normal Balance values and a pure Account model. Reuse the canonical Account ID. Decode invalid persisted values visibly and keep Currency and Normal Balance immutable.

tests: accepts nonblank opaque Currency codes without normalization
rejects negative or unsafe exponents and Minor Units
accepts negative balance amounts
compares Currency by code and exponent
builds the three Account balance views
acceptance: Pure domain modules import no Effect, Fastify, Drizzle, or PostgreSQL code
No duplicate Account ID brand is introduced

tasks.name: Add the Account schema migration
inputs: Current Account, Entry, Settlement, and Ledger tables
tasks.description: Expand and backfill Account Currency, verify financial and tenancy invariants, add Account constraints and the composite Ledger foreign key, then drop Ledger Currency columns. Update the Drizzle schema to the contracted model.

tests: fresh migrations apply to PostgreSQL
existing Accounts receive their Ledger Currency pair
cross-Organization Account and Ledger pairs are rejected
Ledger Currency columns no longer exist
acceptance: Account Currency columns are non-null and have no defaults
Migration verification fails before contraction on invalid data

tasks.name: Implement the Effect Account repository
inputs: Account domain and contracted Drizzle schema
tasks.description: Implement tenant-scoped list, get, create, versioned update, and delete operations with typed row decoding and database error translation. Map only the named Account name constraint to duplicate-name Conflict.

tests: list ordering and pagination are stable
all operations enforce Organization and Ledger scope
create starts at lockVersion 1
first update succeeds and overlapping updates conflict
duplicate names map to AccountNameConflict
dependent delete maps to AccountHasDependents
invalid rows map to persistence decoding failure
acceptance: Repository methods return Effects with typed expected errors
Create and update use separate SQL statements

tasks.name: Implement Account service, schemas, and routes
inputs: Existing permission names and route registration
tasks.description: Implement Account orchestration, TypeBox contracts, serialization, direct Effect handlers, runtime Layer composition, and route registration for all five endpoints. Replace the legacy public Account service and routes.

tests: all five routes preserve permissions and paths
create requires Currency and Normal Balance and returns 201 with Location
response contains top-level Currency without repeated balance Currency
update preserves immutable fields and uses internal version checking
delete returns an empty 204
routes omit unused 429 responses
acceptance: Handlers use the existing server runtime directly
No generic runner, route adapter, or test harness is added

tasks.name: Switch Transactions to Account-owned Currency
inputs: Legacy Transaction service, entity, and repository
tasks.description: Replace TransactionService's Ledger dependency with the temporary Account reader, derive one exact Currency pair from referenced tenant-scoped Accounts, reject mixed pairs, and scope repository Account reads by Organization and Ledger. Preserve the legacy Transaction API and lifecycle.

tests: Transaction entries use Account Currency rather than request or Ledger Currency
mixed Account Currency pairs return Conflict
missing, cross-Ledger, and cross-Organization Accounts are hidden as not found
existing posting and optimistic balance behavior remains green
acceptance: Transaction public schemas and lifecycle remain unchanged
Legacy Account reader is private and marked for Step 04 deletion

tasks.name: Switch Settlements and remove Ledger Currency compatibility
inputs: Legacy service and repository plugin registrations
tasks.description: Derive Settlement Currency and Normal Balance from Accounts, require both Accounts to share a pair, use Effect Ledger for collection parent checks, and stop rereading Ledger during transitions. Remove unused legacy Ledger and public Account Promise code and registrations.

tests: Settlement create and update derive fields from the settled Account
mismatched Account pairs return Conflict
Settlement transition uses the supplied Ledger ID
no production reader references Ledger Currency
acceptance: Legacy Ledger Currency compatibility files are deleted when unused
Legacy Settlement HTTP and lifecycle contracts remain unchanged

tasks.name: Update documentation and verify the migration
inputs: Current ERD and superseded repository and Transaction documents
tasks.description: Update the ERD and focused supersession notices, then run API tests, repository checks, build, and migration validation. Review the full diff for unintended changes.

tests: pnpm --filter=@exchequerio/api test
pnpm run check
pnpm run build
clean PostgreSQL migration run
acceptance: ERD shows Account-owned Currency and no Ledger Currency
Old Currency documentation points to the approved SDD
Full diff contains no unrelated changes
